parsed.about_headline: Reliable Roofing from a Local Ballarat Business
parsed.about_body: I am Hayden, owner of Vicwest Roofing. We have traded in Ballarat since 2017, focusing on honest quotes and fast turnarounds. You need a roof that stops leaking immediately, not sales talk. I personally oversee every job to ensure the team strips old materials correctly and installs new Colorbond systems to last. My VBA licence (CDB-U 65938) proves we meet strict state standards for safety and building codes. When you hire us, you get a direct line to me if issues arise. We do not outsource our accountability. I want your neighbours in Wendouree and Alfredton to see the difference a proper re-roof makes. Call me for a clear, detailed quote without pressure. We clean up after ourselves and leave your property secure.

faqs.q: Are you licensed to work on residential roofs in Victoria?
faqs.a: Yes, Vicwest Roofing holds an active VBA licence (CDB-U 65938). This licence covers roofing and sheeting work for residential and commercial properties in Victoria.

faqs.q: How long does a full roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential re-roofs are completed in one to two days. We remove the old roof, install new battens and sarking, and fix the Colorbond sheets efficiently. Weather delays may affect scheduling.

faqs.q: Do you provide a warranty on your roofing work?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer a 10-year workmanship warranty on all re-roofing projects. This covers installation defects. Colorbond materials also come with their own extensive manufacturer warranties.

faqs.q: Can you remove old asbestos cement roofing safely?
faqs.a: Yes, we safely remove ageing asbestos cement roofs as part of our replacement service. We follow strict safety protocols to handle and dispose of hazardous materials correctly.

faqs.q: What suburbs near Ballarat do you service?
faqs.a: We service Ballarat city, Wendouree, Alfredton, Delacombe, and surrounding areas including Geelong, Bendigo, and Daylesford. Contact us to confirm availability for your specific location.

faqs.q: How much does a roof replacement cost?
faqs.a: Costs vary based on roof size, pitch, and material choice. We provide fixed-price quotes with no hidden fees. Call us for a free, detailed estimate specific to your property.
